implementationConstraints: ACP initialize and session/new are verified via stdio NDJSON in a temporary repository without requesting prompt inference.
Session telemetry comes only from session/update. F03 never sends session/prompt, so usage and cost stay unknown: an unobserved run is not a zero-cost run.
../f00/fixtures/opencode-zai-review.sanitized.json documents a past run and is no longer used as this session's telemetry value.
When session/update does carry usage it is runtime_reported with evidenceStatus inferred: the ACP field mapping has no fixture in 1.18.3.
opencode run accepts the prompt as a positional argument in argv; GitCron uses ACP stdio exclusively.
session/prompt and prompt-time session/update streaming remain pending separate human approval.

adapters.capabilityNote: The wrapper modeling is about OBSERVABILITY, not about what Antigravity can do. As an agent it is a full peer of Claude Code / Codex / OpenCode: agy exposes --print (non-interactive), --model, --effort, --mode (plan|accept-edits), --sandbox, --add-dir, --conversation (resume by id), plus agents, models and plugin subcommands. What it lacks is a machine-readable event stream.
implementationConstraints: agy 1.1.5/1.1.6 exposes no --json / --output-format / --stream flag: --print emits prose, so there is nothing structured to parse.
GitCron models agy as a process lifecycle wrapper without applying regex to raw stdout/stderr text.
Telemetry and token metrics remain unknown without inventing zero values or assumed billing status.
VERSION DRIFT: the adapter baseline is 1.1.5 but the operator machine has 1.1.6 installed; discover() degrades to pending_fixture as designed. Revalidation pending.

UNEXPLORED: agy exposes --remote-control, a mode not documented in --help. If it carries a structured protocol, agy could become a first-class adapter instead of a blind wrapper. Tracked in docs/02_ROADMAP.md.

adapters.scopeNote: F03 models LM Studio as an observable provider only. LM Studio also exposes POST /api/v1/chat with MCP integrations and a server-side agentic loop, which would qualify it as a runtime; that is out of F03 scope and tracked in docs/02_ROADMAP.md.
implementationConstraints: health and models.list prefer the native GET /api/v1/models catalog (max_context_length, loaded_instances, trained_for_tool_use) and fall back to /v1/models, which downgrades evidence to pending_fixture.
context.max_tokens is resolved by model key against the catalog; with an unknown model and more than one loaded instance it stays unknown instead of guessing.
all HTTP goes over node:http to loopback only; a non-loopback base URL is rejected.
discover parses the real `CLI commit: <sha>` from lms --version; a different commit degrades to pending_fixture instead of claiming the baseline.
telemetry.usage stays unknown until a real OpenAI-compatible response is ingested via recordCompletionUsage(); fields the provider omits stay null, never zero.
cost 0 is local_unpriced because local inference has no per-token price; evidenceStatus is inferred until a real response is observed.
No inference is executed: POST /v1/chat/completions, model load and unload are never invoked.
